title: Business Voice Use Policy Builder
disclaimerTop: This tool drafts a starting point for an internal voice-use policy based on the framework in the accompanying article. It is not legal advice and does not replace review by a qualified lawyer — especially for anything involving an employee's consent, cross-border data, or a specific fraud or liability concern.
disclaimerAboveOutput: This is a draft you have generated, not a finished or legally reviewed policy. Have it checked by someone qualified before you rely on it, particularly if consent has not yet been confirmed in writing.

revocationOptions.label: On a known departure or end date

voiceOwnerField.label: Whose voice is this?
voiceOwnerField.helperText: A name or role is enough — e.g. "Maria Keller, Founder" or "Reception team lead." Never enter an ID number, phone number or other sensitive personal data here.

requesterField.label: Who is allowed to request new audio in this voice?
requesterField.helperText: Add every person authorised to generate new speech with this voice. At least one is required.

sections.heading: Scope & Purpose
sections.template: This policy governs the use of a voice clone of {voiceOwner} for the following purpose only: {purpose}. Any use beyond this stated purpose requires new, separate consent before it begins.

templates.written: {voiceOwner} gave informed, written consent for this specific purpose{consentDateClause}. They received: a description of the exact purpose above, the ability to review sample output before it went live, and an explicit statement of their right to withdraw consent at any time. This consent does not extend to any purpose not listed above.
templates.verbal: No consent has been recorded in writing yet for {voiceOwner}. Before this voice is cloned or used for {purpose}, obtain informed, written consent covering: the specific purpose above, the chance to review output before it goes live, and an explicit, ongoing right to withdraw.
templates.none: No consent has been recorded in writing yet for {voiceOwner}. Before this voice is cloned or used for {purpose}, obtain informed, written consent covering: the specific purpose above, the chance to review output before it goes live, and an explicit, ongoing right to withdraw.

sections.heading: Access Control
sections.templateSingular: The following person, and no one else, is authorised to generate new speech using this voice: {requesterList}. Every generation request should be logged with requester, date and stated purpose. Access to voice generation should be kept separate from general content or chat tools used for other work.
sections.templatePlural: The following people, and no one else, are authorised to generate new speech using this voice: {requesterList}. Every generation request should be logged with requester, date and stated purpose. Access to voice generation should be kept separate from general content or chat tools used for other work.

templates.dated: Consent and access end automatically on {revocationDate}. On that date: the underlying voice model should be deleted or deactivated, all generation access listed above tied to this voice should be revoked, and any still-live use (such as a phone greeting) should be replaced or separately reconfirmed in writing with {voiceOwner} before their departure.
templates.ongoing: No departure date is currently scheduled. This policy must be revisited — and access revoked — the moment {voiceOwner} leaves the company or formally withdraws consent, whichever happens first. Do not wait for a scheduled review.

sections.heading: Verification Rule for Sensitive Actions
sections.template: Regardless of how this voice is used, no one may authorise a payment, a change of bank details, a credential reset or any other sensitive action based on a voice or video call alone — including a call that sounds exactly like {voiceOwner}. Any such request must be confirmed through a second, independent channel, such as calling back a phone number already on file before the call took place, not a number supplied during it.

draftBanner.text: DRAFT — NOT READY TO USE. Consent has not yet been confirmed in writing for the voice described below.

confirmedBanner.text: Consent confirmed — this is a draft ready to review, not a legally finalised policy.

sidebarNote.heading: Why this rule exists
sidebarNote.text: In a widely reported 2024 case, fraudsters used AI-generated video and voice of real company executives on a video call to authorise roughly $25 million in transfers. The call looked and sounded completely real. Read the full article for the details.
